title: TMF683 Party Interaction v5.0.0 — Governed Digital Artifact Ingest

provenance_control.authority: Official TM Forum GitHub organization tmforum-apis
provenance_control.reason: The governed ingest stores the authoritative upstream identity and semantic index. The full source remains linked to the official TM Forum repository and may be vendored later if repository policy requires a local snapshot.

PartyInteraction.definition: Captures information about past party interactions so it can be reused in future interactions.

ChannelRef.definition: Reference to the channel associated with a resource, for example a channel used for selling product offerings or opening a trouble ticket.

RelatedChannel.definition: A channel related to another entity; source examples include online web, mobile app and social.

ContactMedium.definition: Indicates the contact medium that could be used to contact the party.

enterprise_binding.channel_enumeration_policy: Concrete enterprise channel values remain Kongoni-derived unless explicitly evidenced by TM Forum source artifacts.
enterprise_binding.provider_separation_policy: Canonical channel semantics are service-provider agnostic. Provider/BSP/transport identifiers belong to implementation bindings, not canonical channel identity.
enterprise_binding.crm_target: Zoho CRM Omnichannel / Party Relationship Lifecycle Management
